prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve movements on the 2012 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003 resulted in a run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m during the year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 75.697m. The Movement in prior years note records a prior-accident-year run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m during the year, arising wholly from reserve movements on the 2012 year of account under a Whole Account Quota Share with Syndicate 2003. This movement represents a small adverse prior-year development (strengthening) relative to opening reserves and is consistent with the gross claims development triangle.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement is taken from Note 9 (Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) which explicitly states a GBP 0.4m run-off deviation. The note language is internally inconsistent ('adverse' vs parenthetical 'release'); sign chosen as adverse = strengthening based on wording. This figure is consistent with the gross claims development triangle (page 30) which, when diagonalised for UW years <=2013, sums to approximately +0.465m. Amount used = 0.4m as per Note 9. Opening reserves sourced from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, 2014 comparative column).
